diagnostic_targets: Low wide transverse solid crest over the eyes, slightly forward-facing concave dish, not a narrow sagittal blade or two separate horns.
Broad blunt spoon-like bill and deep jaw; head retains long face and distinct orbit region.
Deep robust trunk, neck, four limbs and long tapering tail retained; quadrupedal neutral stance with smaller forelimbs and elevated balancing tail.
Mature crest chosen from ROM66180 reference; do not substitute crestless juvenile or tall Corythosaurus helmet.
No sail, nose balloon, armour or exaggerated head spike; uncertain skin represented simply.

scale.basis: NHM Dino Directory estimate; no scale transfer between museum mounts and ROM cranium.

scientific_limits.en: Living reconstruction, not a fossil scan. Nine metres is an NHM taxon estimate, not measured length of the illustrated individuals. Museum mount combines preserved and restored anatomy; tissue, colour and posture are interpretative. Adult cranial reconstruction uses ROM66180, not subadult crest absence.
scientific_limits.zh: 完整活体复原，不是化石扫描。9米为博物馆物种级估值，不是图示个体的实测长度。装架包含复原部分，软组织、颜色与姿态属推断。成体头冠参考ROM66180，不以亚成体缺冠代表成体。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole mature hadrosaur with low broad transverse crest and deep blunt bill; no nest or juvenile substitution.
frozen_scientific_scope.specimen_basis: ROM66180 anterior/anterodorsal cranium Fig4 McFeeters etal2021 supports adult crest; MOR adult skull photograph supports bill. Wyoming Dinosaur Center mounted whole skeleton supports body anatomy; no unverified accession identity asserted.
